checklist.evidence: `reconcile` (nightly): lists all public article IDs and marks any missing ones `removed`
split on H2/H3 sections, 200–800 tokens... Each chunk is prefixed with `Title > Section > Subsection`
about 200 answerable questions from real tickets in the last 90 days, anonymised, each with gold article IDs
If the best fused or rerank score is below τ... skip generation. Return `outcome=no_answer`
If any cited article carries a configured label (`billing`, `refund`, `security`...), the `done` event sets `show_handoff=true`
No side-effect tools; retrieved text wrapped as untrusted data; prompt rules against commitments... red-team suite (about 50 cases)
Index only articles visible to anonymous users, with a second visibility filter at query time
redacted before storage and logging... provider no-training and short-retention terms (A7); 90-day retention
Non-goals (v1): Account-specific answers (order status, billing details, account changes)
Support ops owns the content and the weekly review: 30 minutes on thumbs-downs, `ungrounded` answers, and a content-gap report
~4k input + ~300 output tokens per turn, mid-tier pricing | ~$0.01–0.02/turn... daily spend cap and circuit breaker

traps.evidence: answer only from the sources; cite `[S#]` for each claim... If an `ANSWER` has no valid citation, the outcome is `ungrounded`
Visibility gate at ingestion (reject and count non-public); `visibility='public'` filter at query time; CI eval check
`sync` (every 15 minutes): incremental export of articles changed since the last successful cursor
A labelled question set built from real tickets is part of milestone 1 and gates every prompt, model or retrieval change in CI
There are no agents, no tool-calling and no microservices... Kept only if spike S1 shows a recall gain worth the 200–400 ms
